FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE
THE order under Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451), as amended by Acts, No. 13 of 1966, No.56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009.
The Order

By virtue of powers vested in me by Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) as amended by Acts, No.13 of 1996, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I, Maithripala Sirisena,Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment do by this order declare that Kurana Madakada Forest of 540.725hectares bounded by the limit set forth in the Schedule hereto as Kurana Madakada Reserved Forest from 23 day of September2016.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment.
Ministry of Mahaweli Development and Environment,Battaramulla,2016, August 23.
